scope: Retry recognized temporary provider failures at most once per failed call within the original job budgets.
providers: Simulated model and GitHub responses. The process test uses the real OpenAI SDK with a local mock transport.

cases.model_503_then_success: The same evidence was reused and a final analysis was accepted within six model attempts.
cases.model_retry_on_last_slot: The retry counted as the third request and used tool_choice=none.
cases.model_attempts_exhausted: The terminal job preserved S1 and reported a partial result.
cases.per_call_retry_exhausted: A second temporary model failure stopped the operation with its existing source.
cases.long_retry_after: Waiting longer than the remaining job time preserved the available evidence and made no early retry.
cases.permanent_model_errors: Invalid input, credentials, and insufficient or exhausted quota caused one model request each.
cases.github_tool_budget_exhausted: The failed label lookup did not get another GET, and the final job retained its source and accepted partial content.
cases.github_search_recovered: A temporary error was retried using the original call ID. The successful result counted as one distinct search.
cases.github_candidate_budget_after_interrupti: Both candidate attempts were reserved before sending. Resuming the interrupted retry did not re-read the candidate.
cases.interrupted_model_retry: The replacement run treated the retry as spent and kept the original evidence without another model request.

worker_replacement_during_retry_wait.initial_github_response: HTTP 503 with Retry-After of four seconds for the label catalog
worker_replacement_during_retry_wait.first_worker_stopped_with: SIGTERM during the saved retry wait
